title: Close-up witnesses sensed being watched
summary: David Grusch tells of Close-up witnesses sensed being watched, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've had some folks I talked to that had their own kind of up close kind of sightings. They said that they got that vibe, too,

plain: A former US intelligence officer named David Grusch, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he has talked with people who had their own close-up sightings of unexplained objects. Grusch says they told him they got the same feeling of being watched. If true, it would suggest that close encounters bring a shared sense of being observed.
